subject: general
question: ________ is the largest state in India by land area.
solution:
The correct answer is __Rajasthan.__

__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Rajasthan is the largest state of India in terms of area.
 
• It covers an area of 342,239 sq. km and has a population of 6.85 crores as per the 2011 census.
 
• Uttar Pradesh is the largest state of India in terms of population.
